recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, high-key portrait of a blonde woman looking down with a gentle smile, immersed in a lush field of yellow and orange ranunculus flowers. The image features a shallow depth of field, creating a soft, ethereal glow where the background and foreground flowers blur into washes of color.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject hair color harmonizing with yellow floral tones
Soft-focus foreground elements framing the lower third
High-key lighting creating a halo effect around the subject's head
Text placement anchored in the lower visual weight of the flowers
coreInvariants: Shallow depth of field with blurred floral bokeh
Wide-tracked serif typography at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle and upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point, supported by the sharpest area of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the subject's downward gaze toward the flowers and the text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners are filled with soft-focus green and yellow foliage, providing breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden yellow and warm greens (background and flowers)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep reds and oranges (foreground floral accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, medium-high saturation with a warm tint that reduces blue levels.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or harsh blacks
Limit to warm earth tones and sun-bleached highlights

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines

treatment.shadow: Subtle soft drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone display serif for maximum elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic transitional serif with high legibility and elegant proportions.
High contrast strokes provide a modern, high-fashion feel.
The base skeleton for many similar 90s-era serif designs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus, sun-drenched photograph of a blonde woman smiling and looking down into a field of yellow and orange flowers. The lighting should be warm and high-key, with a shallow depth of field blurring the foreground and background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the display text in a high-contrast white serif font at the bottom of the image. Use all uppercase letters with very wide tracking so the text spans the width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and golden?
Is the text tracking wide enough to span the width?
Are the serifs sharp and visible?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the golden hour glow
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names
Do not replicate exact facial features of the subject
Do not use specific brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for white text legibility against the background
Ensure the color palette is dominated by yellow and green
Verify the shallow depth of field effect
Confirm the serif font has high stroke contrast
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm-toned portrait + shallow depth of field florals + wide-tracked white serif typography = 90s-inspired soft-focus aesthetic.
